branchMethod: Read-only source diff; branch not rebuilt by this sub-audit. All confirmed findings persist unchanged in relevant code.

findings.title: Disabled image-dependent donor fails to supply source to referenced mask
findings.trigger: Enabled borrower references a disabled Brightness Range donor; no other enabled image-dependent mask forces source construction.
findings.effect: Selection disappears; if donor is inverted, the borrowed selection becomes whole-frame.
findings.coverage: Executed fresh PipelineRenderer alpha rendering; source logic shared with production graph. Other image-dependent donor kinds inferred from same guard.
findings.historicalStatus: Known traversal omission discussed in F2 under matte cache; newly reproduced missing-source and inverted whole-frame consequence.
findings.testGap: Dependency helper tests do not drive source construction for an enabled borrower and disabled donor.
findings.suggestedAction: Build picture source from contributing reference closure and add disabled/inverted image-dependent donor pipeline tests.

findings.title: Referenced donor edits do not invalidate borrower alpha cache
findings.trigger: Export native <=1024px image, change referenced donor polygon, export again using same renderer.
findings.effect: Second delivered image retains the previous mask; fresh renderer produces different correct placement.
findings.coverage: Executed exportedImage twice on held renderer and once on fresh renderer, not only an alpha helper.
findings.historicalStatus: Incomplete reference cache key acknowledged in current cache header; durable small-native final-export consequence independently demonstrated.
findings.testGap: No same-renderer small-image final export test after reference donor mutation.
findings.suggestedAction: Fingerprint reference closure including selection/stroke/matte dependencies, test both small and large native images.

findings.title: Local curves ignore mask Brightness-only and Colour-only blend mode
findings.trigger: Non-neutral local channel curve in Colour-only or Brightness-only mask.
findings.effect: Curve changes both luminance and chroma regardless of selected mode.
findings.coverage: CPU numerical reproduction plus GPU unconditional blendMask source trace.
findings.testGap: MaskBlendTests exercise main local stage, not applyLocalCurves.
findings.suggestedAction: Apply selected blend contract to local curve stage and test channel curves in each mode.

findings.title: Brush alpha depends on raster resolution, not just source-normalized stroke
findings.trigger: Size .01, Feather50, Flow10, Ceiling80 horizontal stroke rendered at1024 and4096.
findings.effect: Export coverage/opacity materially stronger than preview. Minimum valid Size.002 can vanish on small images.
findings.coverage: Actual MaskRaster accumulatedBrushPlane at four resolutions; no UI input event simulation.
findings.testGap: Same-resolution accumulation tests do not assert cross-resolution alpha conservation.
findings.suggestedAction: Density-correct stamp spacing/resampling and subpixel coverage; test alpha at multiple output sizes.

findings.title: Negative local Sharpness uses fixed 2.5-pixel blur
findings.trigger: Local Sharpness -100 on fixed normalized texture, preview versus high-resolution export.
findings.effect: Strong small-preview smoothing almost disappears at full resolution.
findings.coverage: Executed CPU and actual GPU. Radius-vs-sigma hypothesis ruled out.
findings.historicalStatus: New adjacency to fixed global sharpening scaling.
findings.testGap: No normalized-scene resolution test for negative local Sharpness.
findings.suggestedAction: Use a defined frame-denominated blur scale and test it across preview/output resolutions.

findings.title: Vignette positioned incorrectly after off-centre crop and horizontal flip
findings.trigger: Crop x.1/y.1/w.35/h.7, Vignette -2 EV Feather75, then horizontal flip and UI crop reflection.
findings.effect: Vignette centre moves outside delivered crop; whole crop darkened instead of only edges.
findings.coverage: Actual GPU vignette followed by app applyGeometry on uniform source; uses same crop reflection as UI.
findings.historicalStatus: New flip consequence adjacent to historical GEO16 straighten mismatch.
findings.testGap: No combined asymmetric crop+flip+vignette uniform-field assertion.
findings.suggestedAction: Map effect coordinates through inverse geometry or apply vignette on final crop grid.

findings.title: Film Strength switches spatial effects on at full amplitude
findings.effect: Tone blends continuously, but full grain and halation are activated at1 and not scaled down by Strength.
findings.coverage: Actual FilmChain scalar responses plus production spatial routing trace; grain appearance still depends on underlying picture density.
findings.testGap: Film tests establish tonal continuity, not whole-chain spatial continuity near zero.
findings.suggestedAction: Define strength scaling for spatial components and test0/1/50/100.

findings.title: Display Transform disabled during partial film blend although still active
findings.effect: Preset, Contrast, Skew, Hue keep and Black target controls cannot be adjusted although they still form the remaining base fraction of output.

evidence.method: Source trace plus existing FilmLabDisplayTransformTests proving partial base influence

findings.coverage: Source-confirmed; no new UI drag execution by this sub-audit.
findings.branchStatus: persists; Contrast .log travel branch change is unrelated
findings.testGap: No UI predicate test comparing inert state to solved blend fraction.
findings.suggestedAction: Disable only for full replacement; describe partial blend honestly.

findings.title: GPU halation gate materially under-produces low-highlight glow versus reference
findings.trigger: Moderately bright scene values .125...1 with halation active.
findings.effect: Reference expects glow where production GPU yields none or materially less.
findings.coverage: Actual GPU measured flat-field glow versus exact CPU profile energy, blur interior eliminates radius influence.
findings.historicalStatus: C1-01 still open. Separate historical sigma*3 error is fixed.
findings.testGap: Bright-block goldens with broad bounds hide low-highlight response disagreement.
findings.suggestedAction: Share energy gate or establish explicit approximation limits over low/high highlight range.

findings.title: Film Exposure does not affect halation onset
findings.effect: Tone sees exposure change but pre-film halation sees neither changed input nor threshold.
findings.coverage: Executed profile parameters plus stage-order source trace; no claim of measured film physics.
findings.testGap: No exposure-equivalence test for film energy and halation source.
findings.suggestedAction: Tie threshold/input to film exposure or explicitly define effect as independent creative bloom.

findings.title: Mask Strength above100 scales Texture/Clarity only in GPU
findings.effect: CPU clamps and does not move; GPU extrapolates. Absolute Kelvin also stops at100 despite blanket help.
findings.coverage: Actual CPU and GPU stages; Kelvin boundary measured separately.
findings.testGap: Strength tests do not cover upper-half travel for these local operators.
findings.suggestedAction: Define common extrapolation/clamp contract, include group*member strength and absolute WB boundaries.

findings.title: Custom60:1 and1:60 crop locks silently resolve to other ratios
findings.trigger: Enter extreme accepted custom ratio on6000x4000 source.
findings.effect: UI lock states a ratio the minimum5%-dimension crop cannot satisfy.
findings.coverage: Executed actual CropGeometry.refit and displayedAspect; UI setter source trace.
findings.testGap: Accepted boundary ratios absent from common-ratio tests.
findings.suggestedAction: Constrain accepted ratio by geometry or allow the required crop extent.

findings.title: Ramp shape tooltip describes opposite direction from gamma formula
findings.trigger: Adjust Ramp shape below/above1 following help.
findings.effect: Higher gamma raises density, contrary to help's holds-back description.
findings.coverage: Actual levels helper and current help text.
findings.testGap: Numerical gamma tests are not tied to help direction.
findings.suggestedAction: Correct explanation to match chosen gamma contract.

findings.title: Velvia exposes enabled Halation/Size/Redness despite zero-strength stage
findings.trigger: Select Velvia50 and edit halation controls.
findings.effect: All three controls cannot affect pixels, with no conditional disabled state.
findings.coverage: Executed all six stock profiles and source-checked unconditional UI.
findings.historicalStatus: C1-08 still open; also affects newly exposed Size/Redness.
findings.testGap: No panel applicability predicate matched against stock identity.
findings.suggestedAction: Disable/explain or provide intentional creative override.

findings.title: AI Amount enabled on rendered inputs without any denoise consumer
findings.trigger: JPEG/PNG/TIFF input, choose AI stand-in, vary Amount.
findings.effect: Amount cannot denoise the rendered input; implicit Classic masters can be suppressed without replacement. Tooltip discloses limitation but row remains enabled.

evidence.method: Source consumer trace; only AppleRawSource consumes AppleStandIn NR amounts; rendered decoder ignores them

findings.coverage: Source-confirmed, dedicated rendered-file runtime consequence NOT executed. RAW Amount independently proved live on all three supplied ARWs.
findings.historicalStatus: Current disclosed gap, not an accusation of a hidden fake neural model. Manual Classic userSet coupling is fixed.
findings.testGap: No rendered-input mode/amount eligibility assertion tied to pipeline capability.
findings.suggestedAction: Gate/disable unsupported mode or add a real rendered-input operation.
